name: ReSet Ep 1 : Thief of All Hearts
source:
You play as Miki, whose boyfriend is lost just before Valentine's day. Then, she met a self-proclaimed detective named Mike and his assistant Gerald... Little does she know, that there is an evil reason for all of these and both Mike and Gerald are involved in a dark business...

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=14148]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
